_why: Spec §5.3.4 req 3: overlays stack and the order changes the answer. A segment score shift and a campaign cut-off shift may both apply to one evaluation. The order is part of the overlay definitions, NOT an emergent property of how the cycle happened to run - so it is a declared artefact with its own approval, and it is hashed into overlay_stack_id.

per_campaign_exceptions.rationale: Campaign 31's tree tests the raw behaviour score at L2 and the shifted score at L5; the forum agreed the threshold shift must land first.

_note: An overlay of a kind not listed here has no declared application site and CANNOT be applied. resolve() raises NO_SITE naming the kind. That is deliberate: an overlay kind nobody wired would otherwise be a silent no-op, which is the failure mode §5.3.4 req 6 exists to prevent, one level up from scope.
